hero.subtitle: Translate manga like a pro — right in your browser.
hero.subtitleLine2: AI-powered OCR, one-click cleaning, pixel-perfect typesetting. No install. No cost.

showcase.label: Translation Showcase
showcase.heading: Raw pages in, polished translations out
showcase.description: Watch a single manga page go from raw scan to publish-ready translation — OCR, cleaning, and typesetting all handled by AI.
showcase.step1Desc: AI pinpoints every text region — speech bubbles, captions, and SFX — with pixel-accurate bounding boxes.
showcase.step2Desc: Neural inpainting erases the original text while reconstructing line art and color gradients underneath.
showcase.step3Desc: Context-aware AI translates each line, then places it with the right font, size, and layout — ready to publish.
showcase.translatedBubbleA3: Want to go for a walk?

video.heading: See it in action
video.description: One interface. Import, detect, clean, translate, export.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything a translation team needs
features.description: A full pipeline from raw scans to publish-ready pages — all inside one workspace.
features.aiTranslationDesc: One-click OCR + translation powered by GPT, Gemini, or Claude. 50+ languages with context-aware accuracy.
features.smartCleaningDesc: Neural inpainting erases text and preserves the original art — bubbles, SFX, and all.
features.proTypesettingDesc: Full control over fonts, sizes, rotation, and alignment. Pixel-perfect placement right in the browser.
features.batchProcessingDesc: Drop an entire chapter — up to 80 pages — and process them all with one set of settings.
features.openSourceDesc: Free forever. Self-host, fork, or use it online. Your data never leaves your device.
features.builtForTeamsDesc: Designed for scanlation groups and localization teams. One workflow from raw scans to release.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.heading: Five steps to a finished chapter
workflow.description: A clear pipeline from scans to publish-ready pages.
workflow.importDesc: Drop your pages in — PNG, JPG, or WebP. Up to 80 pages in a single batch.
workflow.detectDesc: AI OCR finds every piece of text: dialogue, captions, and sound effects.
workflow.cleanDesc: Neural inpainting removes the original text and seamlessly rebuilds the art beneath it.
workflow.translateDesc: AI translates across 50+ languages with full context — respecting tone, honorifics, and cultural nuance.
workflow.typesetExportDesc: Place translated text with pixel-perfect precision — then export as PNG, layered PSD, or .koma project.

community.heading: Built by translators, for translators
community.description: KomaKun! was born in the scanlation community. We know the pain of manual OCR, the tedium of cleaning, and the grind of typesetting — because we’ve lived it. Free, open source, and for everyone.

cta.heading: Ready to translate?
cta.description: No sign-up. No cost. Just open your browser and go.

footer.tagline: Open-Source Manga Translation IDE — Built with Next.js & AI
